t: I saw it myself. {whom} went straight up into the air like a sack of feathers
people get picked up off the ground now. that's a thing that happens here
I watched {whom} get flung like a stone from a sling. I'm not sleeping tonight
they say {whom} got thrown halfway across the valley. I half believe it
thrown, they said. people don't just fall UP, so something did the throwing
somebody flew, somebody fell, and the story grows every time it's told
it set {whom} down gentle as you'd put down an egg. I saw the whole thing
the ground shook and there was a crash you could feel in your teeth. I was right there
did you feel that crash earlier? whatever it was, I'm glad I wasn't under it
food just appeared. out of nowhere, right where we needed it. I saw it land
they're saying the food in the square just showed up on its own
we were fed when we had nothing. I know a gift when I eat one
free food, sure. and I say someone just miscounted the baskets
the sky came down on {whom} and there's nothing left but scorched grass. I saw it

they say {whom} was struck down out of a clear sky. clear sky, no storm
struck down for something, mark me. the sky doesn't miss
lightning kills somebody every few years. it's sad, it's not a message
a whole tree ripped up by the roots, right in front of me. roots and all
you seen that tree by the ridge? something tore it out like a weed
the wall mended itself. I watched the crack close up like it was never there
broken one day, whole the next, and no one lifted a tool. explain that
the ground rolled under my feet like water. I thought that was the end of us
you felt the shaking too, right? the whole village felt it
the earth doesn't shake itself. someone shook it
{whom} is gone. I was there. I don't want to talk about the details
did you hear about {whom}? terrible thing. terrible
we lost {whom}. the fire feels smaller tonight
a baby came through the whole thing healthy and yelling. that's the best news all season
the bushes went heavy with fruit overnight. I picked till my basket broke
everything's blooming at once out east. go see it before the birds get it
the land doesn't bloom like that on its own. that's a thank-you or an ask
good soil, good rain, good luck. no mystery in a berry
a wolf came at me out past the trees. I got away, but only just
I've got teeth marks in my leg. I'm not going back out there alone
it had me down. I don't want to talk about how close that was
we need somebody watching the treeline. I'm saying that as the one who got bit
I keep hearing it behind me and there's nothing there
a wolf went for {whom} right in front of me and I couldn't do a thing
I watched {whom} get dragged before we got it off them
you heard about {whom}? a wolf, out past the trees
they're saying the wolves aren't scared of us any more
somebody came home torn up yesterday. nobody's saying much about it
I'm not walking that road on my own now, and neither should you
the woods are owed something, and they came and took it
a wolf is a wolf. it was hungry, that's the whole of it
post a man on the edge and this stops. that's all it needs
I saw it happen. {whom} just lifted right off the ground
they're saying {whom} got picked up like it was nothing
I saw {whom} go flying. I don't know how else to say it
people say {whom} got thrown hard enough to leave a mark
I watched {whom} get put back down. gentle, but still not normal
they say {whom} was set down like somebody had hold of them
I heard the crash before I saw anything. scared me half to death
everyone heard that hit. don't let anybody tell you they didn't
food showed up right when we needed it. I was standing there
they say food turned up from nowhere. nobody's complaining
call it luck if you want. hungry people got fed
I saw {whom} struck down. I wish I hadn't
one moment {whom} was there, then the sky hit
they're saying {whom} was smote. I hope they're wrong
I don't like smiting. even when people say it was deserved
I saw that tree come up roots and all. nobody touched it
a whole tree got pulled up. that's what they're saying
I watched the damage fix itself. tools don't work like that
they say the broken part is whole again. no builder did it
the ground moved under me. I nearly went flat on my face
the shaking reached everybody. even the calm ones looked scared
{whom} is dead. I heard it from somebody who was there
I saw what happened to {whom}. I don't want that in my head
the baby made it. sometimes that's enough good news for one day
mother and baby are alive. that's what matters
I saw the bushes heavy with fruit. more than yesterday, easy
people are saying the berries came in all at once
I saw the wolf hit {whom}. it was fast and ugly
{whom} got mauled. that's not a rumor, that's real
someone needs to do something about the wolves before it happens again
somebody in the next valley got carried off the ground, or so it reaches me
the story going round is a man went up. I've had it off three people and no two agree
they say a man was thrown further than a man goes. I wasn't there and neither was anyone I asked
there's a story about someone being set down safe out of the air. nice, if it's true
something came down hard somewhere east. that's as much as anyone can tell me
I hear there was food nobody carried in. I'd like to meet whoever saw it
word is somebody was struck out of a clear sky. it's been passed along a lot of mouths
the story's grown every time I've heard it. by now it's a whole field burnt
they're telling it that a tree came out of the ground on its own. I only have it third-hand
somebody's wound closed up overnight, they say. nobody can tell me whose
the ground shook somewhere out that way. I felt nothing here, but they swear to it

I was outside the door the whole time. she's alright, and so is the baby
